messages.content:
You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  courts: columns=[id, name, court_type, jurisdiction, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, postal_code, country, phone, email, chief_judge_name, is_active, created_at]
  law_firms: columns=[id, name, bar_number, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, postal_code, country, phone, email, website, founded_date, is_active, created_at]
  judges: columns=[id, court_id, first_name, last_name, middle_name, title, bar_number, appointment_date, tenure_end_date, specialization, email, phone, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[court_id→courts]
  attorneys: columns=[id, law_firm_id, first_name, last_name, middle_name, bar_number, bar_state, bar_admission_date, specialization, email, phone, hourly_rate, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[law_firm_id→law_firms]
  clients: columns=[id, client_type, first_name, last_name, organization_name, date_of_birth, tax_id, email, phone, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, postal_code, country]
  case_types: columns=[id, name, category, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  case_statuses: columns=[id, name, description, is_terminal, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  statutes: columns=[id, code, title, description, jurisdiction, category, effective_date, repeal_date, penalty_description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  cases: columns=[id, case_number, court_id, judge_id, case_type_id, case_status_id, title, description, filed_date, closed_date, estimated_trial_date, actual_trial_date, is_sealed, is_expedited, notes], fks=[court_id→courts, judge_id→judges, case_type_id→case_types, case_status_id→case_statuses]
  party_roles: columns=[id, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  parties: columns=[id, case_id, client_id, attorney_id, party_role_id, first_name, last_name, organization_name, is_pro_se, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[case_id→cases, client_id→clients, attorney_id→attorneys, party_role_id→party_roles]
  hearing_outcomes: columns=[id, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  hearings: columns=[id, case_id, judge_id, hearing_outcome_id, hearing_type, scheduled_at, started_at, ended_at, location, courtroom, notes, transcript_available, is_cancelled, cancellation_reason, created_at], fks=[case_id→cases, judge_id→judges, hearing_outcome_id→hearing_outcomes]
  document_types: columns=[id, name, category, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  documents: columns=[id, case_id, document_type_id, filed_by_attorney_id, hearing_id, title, description, file_path, file_name, file_size_bytes, mime_type, filed_date, is_sealed, is_redacted, version], fks=[case_id→cases, document_type_id→document_types, filed_by_attorney_id→attorneys, hearing_id→hearings]
  charges: columns=[id, case_id, party_id, statute_id, charge_description, charge_level, charge_degree, charge_date, is_dismissed, dismissal_reason, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[case_id→cases, party_id→parties, statute_id→statutes]
  verdicts: columns=[id, case_id, charge_id, verdict_type, verdict_date, rendered_by, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[case_id→cases, charge_id→charges]
  sentences: columns=[id, case_id, verdict_id, party_id, judge_id, sentence_type, sentence_date, incarceration_months, probation_months, fine_amount, community_service_hours, restitution_amount, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[case_id→cases, verdict_id→verdicts, party_id→parties, judge_id→judges]
  appeals: columns=[id, original_case_id, appeal_case_id, appellate_court_id, filing_party_id, verdict_id, sentence_id, appeal_type, grounds, filed_date, decision_date, outcome, outcome_notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[original_case_id→cases, appeal_case_id→cases, appellate_court_id→courts, filing_party_id→parties, verdict_id→verdicts, sentence_id→sentences]
  evidence_types: columns=[id, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at]
  evidence: columns=[id, case_id, evidence_type_id, submitted_by_party_id, hearing_id, exhibit_number, description, collection_date, collection_location, chain_of_custody, storage_location, file_path, file_name, file_size_bytes, mime_type], fks=[case_id→cases, evidence_type_id→evidence_types, submitted_by_party_id→parties, hearing_id→hearings]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['courts', 'law_firms', 'judges', 'attorneys', 'clients', 'case_types', 'case_statuses', 'statutes', 'cases', 'party_roles', 'parties', 'hearing_outcomes', 'hearings', 'document_types', 'documents', 'charges', 'verdicts', 'sentences', 'appeals', 'evidence_types', 'evidence']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: legal / legal_case_management
  Metrics:  case_duration_days, hearing_count_per_case, conviction_rate, total_fines_assessed, appeals_filed, case_filing_volume
  Goals:    case_outcome_analysis, attorney_performance_tracking, court_workload_monitoring, charge_and_verdict_reporting
  Grain:    case

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  courts: dimension
  law_firms: dimension
  judges: dimension
  attorneys: dimension
  clients: dimension
  case_types: reference
  case_statuses: reference
  statutes: dimension
  cases: fact
  party_roles: reference
  parties: fact
  hearing_outcomes: reference
  hearings: fact
  document_types: reference
  documents: fact
  charges: fact
  verdicts: fact
  sentences: fact
  appeals: fact
  evidence_types: reference
  evidence: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  documents: file_size_bytes
  sentences: fine_amount, community_service_hours, restitution_amount
  evidence: file_size_bytes
